updates: Closes the prompt_image_dimensions_fit blocker in readable-contracts.json; the floating-point resize proof remains open.

contracts.property: Exact equivalence between acceptance and dimension/ceiling-patch limits. Contract now uses readable result and limits.max_dimension/max_patches field expressions.
The product of u32 side counts fits in u64; the fact now propagates through lossless widening.
New readable requires and inline assertion establish that increasing either cap cannot reject already admitted dimensions; both calls use the checked predicate contract.

new_models.unsigned_div_ceil: Exact (num + rhs - 1) / rhs in mathematical integers, with rhs > 0 required. All unsigned widths.
new_models.unsigned_From: Exact value preservation for the portable lossless unsigned From implementations. No narrowing, floating-point, or lossy cast assumptions added.
new_models.trust: External models are assumptions, audited against pinned Rust source and native boundary/property tests. Model tests can falsify claims but are not a formal proof of Rust internals.

readability: Named-field expressions lower to refinement-record projections; PromptImageResizeLimits refinements now use and bind the actual Rust field names.

validation.arithmetic_cases: 65,280 exhaustive u8 ceiling pairs, u64/u128 boundary cases, 65,536 u16 widening cases and 49 patch products.
validation.oracle: The new Codex test calls the real resize routine and checks resulting dimensions using independent u128 integer patch arithmetic; no image allocation required.
validation.mutation: Replacing width.div_ceil(32) with width/32 fails the readable predicate postcondition. Original source restored byte-for-byte: its git-diff SHA256 equals the final positive run.
validation.scope: Only the admission predicate and two local proofs are selected. Other bodies and external library models remain assumptions. Host/default-feature configuration only.

remaining: The full floating-point resize body previously timed out after 180 seconds and has not been proved.
Positive custom-limit preconditions remain to be established by public callers.
Other Codex contracts and the full readable frontend remain incremental work.
reproduce: Build Flux at flux_commit; run tools/codex/corpus.py check on a prepared clone of this branch with --package codex-utils-image --only-check def:prompt_image_dimensions_fit --only-check def:image_proofs:: --timeout 60 --offline and a fresh --output directory.
